field.name: Link
field.summary: True when the Tool host lifetime should also be registered in the managed WebApplication services.

field.name: Connect
field.summary: True when a shared instance should be registered in the managed WebApplication services.

field.name: Console
field.summary: True when the ToolWebHost should use console lifetime behavior.

field.name: builder
field.summary: The managed used for ASP.NET Core application composition.

method.name: CreateApplicationConnection
method.summary: Create and register the shared connection when application connection is enabled.
method.param: The Tool host lifetime; no connection is created when it is absent.
method.returns: The registered connection, or null when connection is disabled or no Tool lifetime is available.
method.remarks: Registers the connection in the managed services.

method.name: LinkApplicationLifetime
method.summary: Register the Tool host lifetime in managed WebApplication services when lifetime linking is enabled.
method.param: The Tool host lifetime to register.
method.remarks: Does nothing when linking is disabled or no Tool lifetime is available.

method.name: configuretoolwebhost
method.summary: Execute Tool Web Host Configuration Actions.

method.name: configuretoolwebhostasync
method.returns: A Task that represents the asynchronous operation.

method.name: ConfigureToolWebHost_NoSync
method.summary: Add a tool web host configuration action without acquiring the builder synchronization semaphore.
method.remarks: Registers a synchronous ToolWebHost-configuration step in the shared ordered ToolWebHost-configuration pipeline.

method.name: ConfigureToolWebHostAsync_NoSync
method.summary: Add an async ToolWebHost configuration action without acquiring the builder synchronization semaphore.
method.remarks: Registers an asynchronous ToolWebHost-configuration step in the shared ordered ToolWebHost-configuration pipeline.
